title: CBO JOIN 重排：左深树 vs 右深树的中间结果行数
code:
CARD = {"A": 1000, "B": 200000, "C": 100}
SEL_AB, SEL_BC = 0.0005, 0.0001

print("表基数: A=" + str(CARD["A"]) + " B=" + str(CARD["B"]) + " C=" + str(CARD["C"]))
print("连接选择率: A-B=" + str(SEL_AB) + "  B-C=" + str(SEL_BC) + "  A-C 无谓词=1.0(笛卡尔积)")
print("")

cands = []

# 候选1：左深树 ((A JOIN B) JOIN C)
ab = int(CARD["A"] * CARD["B"] * SEL_AB)
abc = int(ab * CARD["C"] * SEL_BC)
cands.append(("左深树 ((A JOIN B) JOIN C)",
              [("A JOIN B", ab), ("(A JOIN B) JOIN C", abc)], ab + abc, abc))

# 候选2：右深树 (A JOIN (B JOIN C))
bc = int(CARD["B"] * CARD["C"] * SEL_BC)
a_bc = int(CARD["A"] * bc * SEL_AB)
cands.append(("右深树 (A JOIN (B JOIN C))",
              [("B JOIN C", bc), ("A JOIN (B JOIN C)", a_bc)], bc + a_bc, a_bc))

# 候选3：无谓词的两表先做（笛卡尔积），再 JOIN 第三张
ac = int(CARD["A"] * CARD["C"] * 1.0)
ac_b = int(ac * CARD["B"] * SEL_AB)
cands.append(("左深树 ((A CROSS C) JOIN B)",
              [("A CROSS C", ac), ("(A CROSS C) JOIN B", ac_b)], ac + ac_b, ac_b))

for name, steps, mid, final in cands:
    print(name)
    for sname, rows in steps:
        print("   中间结果 " + sname + " = " + str(rows))
    print("   中间结果总行数 = " + str(mid) + "   估计最终行数 = " + str(final))

print("")
print("== 按中间结果总行数升序排列（排序保证输出确定性） ==")
for name, steps, mid, final in sorted(cands, key=lambda x: (x[2], x[0])):
    print("  " + str(mid) + "  " + name)

best = sorted(cands, key=lambda x: (x[2], x[0]))[0]
left = [c for c in cands if c[0].startswith("左深树 ((A JOIN B)")][0]
right = [c for c in cands if c[0].startswith("右深树")][0]
cross = [c for c in cands if "CROSS" in c[0]][0]

print("")
print("CBO 选中的连接顺序 = " + best[0])
print("判据 右深树中间结果行数 < 左深树: " + str(right[2] < left[2]) +
      "   (" + str(left[2]) + " -> " + str(right[2]) + ")")
print("中间结果行数下降倍数 = " + str(round(left[2] / right[2], 2)))
print("说明: 候选3 先做笛卡尔积，估计的最终行数被放大到 " + str(cross[3]) +
      "（估计值 != 真实结果），CBO 正是靠代价比较把它排除")
print("判据 笛卡尔积前置的中间结果行数 > 左深树的 10 倍: " + str(cross[2] > left[2] * 10) +
      "   倍数 = " + str(round(cross[2] / left[2], 2)))
